One language-name table (src/aurora/language_strings.h line 30) drives the language list and string lookup.
Per-area minimap as one image chosen by area name, shown or hidden (src/engines/sonic/areaminimap.cpp lines 44 and 62). The file is 90 lines; the body was not read.
Core plus per-game front-ends: shared aurora/ and common/ core under per-game engine folders. Matches our one-engine, zones-as-data ruling.
The donor says no normal gameplay is implemented yet (README line 36), so there is little gameplay to take from it.
